content.title: Ratification of the Marlow Accord by Orbany
content.body:
Document reference: OFFICIAL-PRIMARY-2031-04-20
Effective: 2031-04-20

Summary: This specification confirms the ratification status of the Marlow Accord with respect to Orbany.

Status: Ratified

VALUE AS WRITTEN: yes

Details: The Marlow Accord Authority hereby records that Orbany has ratified the Marlow Accord. This ratification is effective as of the date of this document. All provisions of the Accord shall apply to Orbany in full, and Orbany's obligations under the Accord are hereby acknowledged and accepted. This document serves as the official primary reference for the ratification status. Any inquiries regarding this specification should be directed to the Marlow Accord Authority.
